observations.result_summary: At the canonical assessed superharness revision, first-party native tests construct concrete project-rule files and verify those rules are parsed and exposed through adapter payload and handoff-loading surfaces. The shipped rule CLI reads, lists, shows, and searches the project rule directory, and project initialization creates the rules surface.
observations.notes: This record is function-neutral. The concrete rule files are created directly by test fixture setup rather than through an exercised owner/operator keep, approve, edit, or amendment path. The shipped rules CLI at this revision is read-only with respect to rule mutation. The record therefore establishes project-rule representation and downstream transport/consumption mechanics, not a tested legitimate authoritative policy decision, autonomous ultimate-policy ownership, production deployment history, or a materially matched cross-system result.
